data_and_lifetime.upstream_writes: NAND bootstrap may seed missing files even for configured NAND. Logs contains per-run console/crash evidence; upstream removes entries older than four days on startup. No Core retention or migration promise.
data_and_lifetime.lifetime: Source main calls RuntimeMain; ordinary game runs in selected process, joins/stops workers and shuts down before return. Upstream setup GameLaunchService also starts Base executable with Base CWD/noargs and waits. Source review is not binary/source attestation or an actual game run.
data_and_lifetime.direct_registration_limit: Does not perform upstream install lock, provenance/ready checks or moved-install healing. Close all actual players and preserve runtime/data before upstream repair/update; no concurrent replacement promise.
